notes: Google Veo 3.1 Lite on kie.ai's legacy endpoint (/api/v1/veo/generate, model veo3_lite), the only endpoint where the tier can be chosen. Flat price per clip up to 8 s: 30 credits at 720p, 35 at 1080p (live pricing, 2026-09-24). Speech is generated from quoted dialogue in the prompt; no character or voice lock, so talking shots use frames mode from the storyboard panel. enableTranslation is sent as false so dialogue is not translated. Paid pilot 2026-09-28: 5 of 5 clips at 1080p in frames mode (first + last frame), 35 credits each.
